rules.message: The sentinel fetches the next batch: data-hx-get with the after= cursor on the sentinel row.
The sentinel loads when it comes into view: data-hx-trigger="revealed" (window-scrolled feeds) or "intersect once root:<container>" (container-scrolled grids — see the carve-out).
The sentinel must replace ITSELF: data-hx-swap="outerHTML" — anything else accumulates loading rows instead of renewing the one sentinel.
Keep the sentinel cell aria-live="polite" — its slot becomes the end-of-list marker ("40 of 40"), announced without focus theft.
